name: Solid Voxelization via 6-Direction Odd-Even Ray Parity
definition: A method to convert a normalized, watertight MeshData into a solid voxel target by determining if a voxel center is inside or outside the mesh using the parity of ray intersections along six axis-aligned directions.
summary: Solid Voxelization via 6-Direction Odd-Even Ray Parity converts watertight meshes to solid voxels using deterministic axis-aligned ray parity and majority voting, offering a robust, non-stochastic alternative to random ray casting.
